title: The Year Cicely Saunders Decided Her Hospice Would Not Be Exclusive
conflicts: Beds in The Scheme: David Clark says 60, the New York Times obituary says 100; no figure used. notes: Episode shifted within the same founding story: the slate named the 1967 opening, but the documented decision is the 1960 choice of an interdenominational foundation over an Anglican religious community (from Saunders's letters, via David Clark); the story runs from that decision to the July 1967 opening and approx_date is 1960-12.
